{{Quote|Flight Commander Pirul, my lord. If you possess a ship, I could certainly use your talents.|Pirul|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Pirul''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Flight Commander/Legends|Flight Commander]] within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Faced with an increasing number of Republic attacks in space, he mobilized the [[Kaas Twenty-third]] and [[Dread Wing]] squadrons to repel the invaders, but their efforts proved insufficient. To combat the threat, he oversaw the formation of an elite attack squadron called [[Empire's Fury]]. Pirul personally contacted the [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]], the [[Darth Nox|Sith Apprentice]] of [[Darth Zash]], Intelligence [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]] and a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter participating in the Great Hunt]] and persuaded them to lend their effort to the Empire's cause.

==Behind the scenes==
Pirul was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a massively multiplayer online role-playing game released by BioWare on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He contacts Imperial players on board their ship by holocomm, just after they complete their Dromund Kaas storylines and receive their own ship. He recruits the player into the Empire's Fury Squadron, which serves as the plotline for the space missions available to the players.
